title: Cross-Care: Assessing the Healthcare Implications of Pre-training Data on Language Model Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the co-occurrences of disease terms and racial/ethnic group keywords in pre-training corpora (like The Pile) and comparing them with language model logits derived from templated prompts and real-world disease prevalence data from the CDC.

Calculating the co-occurrences of disease terms and gender keywords (male, female, non-binary) in pre-training corpora and comparing them with language model logits derived from templated prompts and real-world disease prevalence data from the CDC.
